﻿# Codex config
model = "gpt-5"

[mcp_servers.context7]
command = "npx"   # docs
args = [
  "-y",
  "@upstash/context7-mcp",
]

[mcp_servers.context7.env]
DEBUG = "1"

[mcp_servers."my-shell"]
command = "/usr/local/bin/shell-mcp"

[mcp_servers.remote]
url = "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"

[profiles.fast]
model = "gpt-5-mini"
